meta.scope: Philippines Batch 12 — Defence budget, irrigation/water resources, and science & technology / R&D statistics.

candidates.title: Department of National Defense / AFP budget statistics
candidates.description: Official budget allocations for the Department of National Defense and the major services (Army, Navy, Air Force). Provides the resource base for defence and security analysis.

candidates.title: Defence and security policy framing
candidates.description: Recurring policy framing of Philippine defence and security priorities, including territorial defence, maritime security and internal security dimensions.
candidates.notes: Policy-frame counterpart to the defence budget node.

candidates.title: Irrigation development and status statistics
candidates.description: Official status of irrigation development — area irrigated, systems, and related indicators. Critical for rice production and agricultural resilience.

candidates.title: Water resources and water-security framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from NIA, DENR and planning sources
candidates.description: Policy and statistical framing of water resources, irrigation and water security that links agriculture, urban demand and climate resilience.

candidates.title: Science, technology and R&D statistics
candidates.publisher: Department of Science and Technology (DOST) / PSA related
candidates.description: Official statistics on research and development expenditure, personnel and related S&T indicators. Provides the innovation and knowledge-generation base.

candidates.title: Philippines defence–water–R&D densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from DND, NIA and DOST sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding defence budget and policy framing, irrigation development statistics, water-resources framing, and science/technology/R&D statistics into a coherent security–water–innovation layer.
